title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I was really excited to get my first cordless vacuum and did alot of research to find a affordable but decent product. This vacuum is perfect except my battery dies within 10 minutes and loses suction very fast

product_metadata.title: Belife Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, 2 Battery Stick Vacuum with Max 80mins Runtime, 25Kpa Powerful Suction, LED Display, Lightweight Handheld Vacuum for Hard Floor Carpet Car Pet Hair
features: 🏡2 Detachable batteries & up to 80mins Runtime: The rechargeable vacuum cordless features a 2600 m-A-h larger capacity battery (7 cells), this pet vacuum offers longer working time than other cordless vacuum cleaner. Up to 80mins in total at eco mode, ensures thorough deep cleaning all around the house.

🏡Touch Screen & LED Display: Large touch screen LED control panel makes it effortless to adjust the vacuum power and know the status your vacuum cleaner. This design is more convenient and trouble-free compared with traditional button operation. The control panel shows the battery level, suction performance, brush roller tangled and air channel blocked.

🏡380w Brushless Digital Motor & Motorized Brush Head: Brushless motor can reach 90,000rpm, generating 25Kpa strong suction. Equiped with powerful motorized led floor head, it is great for cleaning up crumbs on the kitchen floor after dinner, LED headlights can clean up the dirt on the bottom of the bed, couch, furniture and dark places visually.

🏡Cordless and Lightweight: Belife BVC11 vacuum cleaner is equipped with multiple brush heads and telescopic link, which can be assembled arbitrarily for easy cleaning of stairs, cars, curtains and other difficult places. Lightweight design allows you to operate with one hand effortlessly. This cordless vacuum must be a great gift for your family or friends who have pets or naughty kids.

🏡6-Layer Efficiency Filtration System：Fully sealed filtration system captures fine particles, 99.99% micro dust as small as 0.1um, expels ultimate purified air for your family and prevents secondary air pollution. Standing with one hand pull can empty 0.7L dust cup, completely say goodbye to dust inhalation.
